_doc: c57 (critic A #3, coordinator 1b): actions on LEVEL_SHAPES edges of 2.5 dB or more within 0.12 s inside a sounding string note (NOTE_LEVEL 'edges'), from the c56 stems (cycles/c57/actor_scripts/edges57.py): an edge whose stem step is at least 1 dB smaller with the item than without stays (not listed); an edge next to a rest (stem step 8 dB or more without the item) stays; an edge that adds a step where the stem has under 1 dB without it drops its lobe when the lobe lasts 1 s or less; an edge within 0.2 s of its note's start moves back to the note's level change; the others move to the next score onset when it is at most an eighth away, else become a ramp to the next onset or the note's end.
